Resists discretionary departures from a common process. Values reducing safety exposure even when action becomes slower. Treats broad access as secondary to maintaining bounded eligibility. Has no fixed preference for continuity over interruption. Values controls that make exceptions auditable.

factions.name: Implementation council
factions.summary: Balances operational continuity with reviewable safeguards. Value profile used for this panel: access=0.2, adaptability=0.4, continuity=0.8, oversight=0.6, safety=0.5. Prioritizes conservative safeguards when consequences are uncertain. Values discretion to adapt a rule to the facts of a case. Prioritizes explicit approval and reviewable decision authority. Prioritizes continuity when the normal workflow is interrupted. Has no fixed preference for expanding or narrowing access.

factions.name: Access delegates
factions.summary: Prioritizes workable exceptions for people facing access barriers. Value profile used for this panel: access=0.9, adaptability=0.6, continuity=0.5, oversight=-0.1, safety=0.2. Balances formal oversight with direct operating authority. Prioritizes continuity when the normal workflow is interrupted. Values discretion to adapt a rule to the facts of a case. Prioritizes broad access when procedures exclude affected people. Has no fixed preference for more or less precaution.

factions.name: Affected community
factions.summary: Wants accessible exceptions and timely resolution. Value profile used for this panel: access=0.8, adaptability=-0.2, continuity=0.3, oversight=0.5, safety=0.8. Values making services reachable through more than one channel. Values keeping essential operations moving through disruption. Has no fixed preference between discretion and uniform treatment. Values reducing safety exposure even when action becomes slower. Values controls that make exceptions auditable.
